nodes.name: cubeSpin
nodes.coreScript:
local ax, ay, az = 0, 0, 0
local lift = 2.0
local FAST = 4.0
-- Starts fast; the poke that sows the flowers is what slows it.
local speed = FAST

-- Animating here means spinning fast. The cube's poke sends an animate action clearing it.
function init()
	setAnimating(true)
end

function invoke()
	if not getStrobe() then return end
	local target = getAnimating() and FAST or 1.0
	-- Eased rather than switched, so the cube winds down over a second or two instead of jolting.
	speed = speed + (target - speed) * 0.04
	ax = (ax + 0.007 * speed) % (2 * math.pi)
	ay = (ay + 0.011 * speed) % (2 * math.pi)
	az = (az + 0.004 * speed) % (2 * math.pi)
	local cx, sx = math.cos(ax), math.sin(ax)
	local cy, sy = math.cos(ay), math.sin(ay)
	local cz, sz = math.cos(az), math.sin(az)
	-- Rz * Ry * Rx, written out column by column.
	setTransform{
		cz * cy, sz * cy, -sy, 0,
		cz * sy * sx - sz * cx, sz * sy * sx + cz * cx, cy * sx, 0,
		cz * sy * cx + sz * sx, sz * sy * cx - cz * sx, cy * cx, 0,
		0, lift, 0, 1}
end

nodes.name: cube
nodes.coreScript:
local half = 1.2
-- Odd, so no grid point falls on a face's centre, where the radial and angular patterns have no direction.
local GRID = 11
-- Red to violet, stopping short of the wrap back round to red.
local SPAN = 5 / 6

-- Each face lays the spectrum out in its own pattern, s and t running -1 to 1 across it.
local faces = {
	{n = { 1, 0, 0}, u = {0, 1, 0}, v = {0, 0, 1}, hue = function(s, t) return (s + 1) / 2 * SPAN end},
	{n = {-1, 0, 0}, u = {0, 0, 1}, v = {0, 1, 0}, hue = function(s, t) return (s + t + 2) / 4 * SPAN end},
	{n = { 0, 1, 0}, u = {0, 0, 1}, v = {1, 0, 0}, hue = function(s, t) return math.sqrt(s * s + t * t) / math.sqrt(2) * SPAN end},
	{n = { 0,-1, 0}, u = {1, 0, 0}, v = {0, 0, 1}, hue = function(s, t) return math.abs(math.atan(t, s)) / math.pi * SPAN end},
	{n = { 0, 0, 1}, u = {1, 0, 0}, v = {0, 1, 0}, hue = function(s, t) return (1 - (math.abs(s) + math.abs(t)) / 2) * SPAN end},
	{n = { 0, 0,-1}, u = {0, 1, 0}, v = {1, 0, 0}, hue = function(s, t) return math.abs(t) * SPAN end}
}

local function hsvToRgb(h, sat, val)
	local chroma = val * sat
	local huePrime = (h % 1) * 6
	local x = chroma * (1 - math.abs((huePrime % 2) - 1))
	local m = val - chroma
	local r, g, b
	if huePrime < 1 then r, g, b = chroma, x, 0
	elseif huePrime < 2 then r, g, b = x, chroma, 0
	elseif huePrime < 3 then r, g, b = 0, chroma, x
	elseif huePrime < 4 then r, g, b = 0, x, chroma
	elseif huePrime < 5 then r, g, b = x, 0, chroma
	else r, g, b = chroma, 0, x end
	return {(r + m) * 255, (g + m) * 255, (b + m) * 255, 255}
end

-- Walked so that u x v = n, which winds each face counter-clockwise seen from outside.
local function corner(f, s, t)
	local p = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do p[i] = half * (f.n[i] + s * f.u[i] + t * f.v[i]) end
	return Vertex{posn = p, colour = hsvToRgb(f.hue(s, t), 0.9, 1.0), normal = f.n}
end

function init()
	for _, f in ipairs(faces) do
		-- A grid rather than one quad, so the colour follows the pattern rather than blending straight across.
		for i = 0, GRID - 1 do
			local s0, s1 = -1 + 2 * i / GRID, -1 + 2 * (i + 1) / GRID
			for j = 0, GRID - 1 do
				local t0, t1 = -1 + 2 * j / GRID, -1 + 2 * (j + 1) / GRID
				local a, b, c, d = corner(f, s0, t0), corner(f, s1, t0), corner(f, s1, t1), corner(f, s0, t1)
				addVertexes({a, b, c, a, c, d})
			end
		end
	end
end
nodes.pokeScript: if POKE_TYPE == "HIT" then emitAction(ActionType.ANIMATE, {animating = false}) trigger("seedBuilder") end

nodes.coreScript:
-- Flower 1 of gardenHive.json, script for script. Petals differ only in hue.
local BODY_CORE = [==[function init() local radius = 0.900000 local latSeg = 10 local lonSeg = 20 local apexR, apexG, apexB = 255, 216.75, 51 local rimR, rimG, rimB = 76.5, 127.5, 38.25 local function ringVertex(latIndex, lonIndex, nx, ny, nz) local latFraction = latIndex / latSeg local phi = latFraction * (math.pi / 2) local y = radius * math.sin(phi) local r = radius * math.cos(phi) local cR = rimR + (apexR - rimR) * latFraction local cG = rimG + (apexG - rimG) * latFraction local cB = rimB + (apexB - rimB) * latFraction local theta = (lonIndex / lonSeg) * (2 * math.pi) local x = r * math.cos(theta) local z = r * math.sin(theta) if not nx then nx, ny, nz = x / radius, y / radius, z / radius end return Vertex{posn = {x, y, z}, colour = {cR, cG, cB, 255}, texCoords = {lonIndex / lonSeg, latFraction}, normal = {nx, ny, nz}} end local function ring(latIndex) local verts = {} for lon = 0, lonSeg do verts[lon + 1] = ringVertex(latIndex, lon) end return verts end local prevRing = ring(0) for lat = 1, latSeg do local currRing = ring(lat) for lon = 1, lonSeg do local bottomLeft, bottomRight = prevRing[lon], prevRing[lon + 1] local topLeft, topRight = currRing[lon], currRing[lon + 1] addVertex(bottomLeft); addVertex(bottomRight); addVertex(topRight) addVertex(bottomLeft); addVertex(topRight); addVertex(topLeft) end prevRing = currRing end for lon = 0, lonSeg - 1 do local centre = Vertex{posn = {0, 0, 0}, colour = {rimR, rimG, rimB, 255}, texCoords = {0.5, 0.5}, normal = {0, -1, 0}} local flatA = ringVertex(0, lon, 0, -1, 0) local flatB = ringVertex(0, lon + 1, 0, -1, 0) addVertex(centre); addVertex(flatB); addVertex(flatA) end local haloInner, haloOuter, haloSeg, haloY = 1.05, 1.65, 48, 0.05 local haloR, haloG, haloB, haloA = 18, 90, 135, 80 local function haloVertex(seg, rad) local a = (seg / haloSeg) * 2 * math.pi return Vertex{posn = {rad * math.cos(a), haloY, rad * math.sin(a)}, colour = {haloR, haloG, haloB, haloA}, texCoords = {seg / haloSeg, 0}, normal = {0, 1, 0}} end local halo = {} for seg = 0, haloSeg - 1 do local i0 = haloVertex(seg, haloInner) local i1 = haloVertex(seg + 1, haloInner) local o0 = haloVertex(seg, haloOuter) local o1 = haloVertex(seg + 1, haloOuter) halo[#halo + 1] = i0; halo[#halo + 1] = o0; halo[#halo + 1] = o1; halo[#halo + 1] = i0; halo[#halo + 1] = o1; halo[#halo + 1] = i1 end addVertexes(halo, VertexVisibility.HOVERED_OVER) end]==]
local BODY_POKE = [==[if POKE_TYPE == "HIT" then setAnimating(not getAnimating(), true) end]==]
local TILT_CORE = [==[function invoke() if getStrobe() and getAnimating() then local t = getTransform(); local angle = math.atan(t[2], t[1]); step = step or 0.0056; local maxTilt = 1.5; if opening then angle = angle - step; if angle <= 0 then angle = 0; opening = false; end else angle = angle + step; if angle >= maxTilt then angle = maxTilt; opening = true; end end local c = math.cos(angle); local s = math.sin(angle); t[1] = c; t[2] = s; t[5] = -s; t[6] = c; setTransform(t);end end]==]
local PETAL_TAIL = [==[ local length, maxHalfWidth, segments = 2.2, 0.45, 10 local function hsvToRgb(h, sat, val) local chroma = val * sat local huePrime = h * 6 local x = chroma * (1 - math.abs((huePrime % 2) - 1)) local m = val - chroma local rp, gp, bp if huePrime < 1 then rp, gp, bp = chroma, x, 0 elseif huePrime < 2 then rp, gp, bp = x, chroma, 0 elseif huePrime < 3 then rp, gp, bp = 0, chroma, x elseif huePrime < 4 then rp, gp, bp = 0, x, chroma elseif huePrime < 5 then rp, gp, bp = x, 0, chroma else rp, gp, bp = chroma, 0, x end return (rp + m) * 255, (gp + m) * 255, (bp + m) * 255 end local baseR, baseG, baseB = hsvToRgb(hue, 0.85, 0.95) local tipR, tipG, tipB = hsvToRgb(hue, 0.25, 1.0) local prevLeft, prevRight for i = 0, segments do local t = i / segments local x = t * length local halfWidth = maxHalfWidth * math.sin(math.pi * t) local cR = baseR + (tipR - baseR) * t local cG = baseG + (tipG - baseG) * t local cB = baseB + (tipB - baseB) * t local left = Vertex{posn = {x, 0, halfWidth}, colour = {cR, cG, cB, 255}, texCoords = {t, 0}, normal = {0, 1, 0}} local right = Vertex{posn = {x, 0, -halfWidth}, colour = {cR, cG, cB, 255}, texCoords = {t, 1}, normal = {0, 1, 0}} if i > 0 then addVertex(prevLeft); addVertex(prevRight); addVertex(right) addVertex(prevLeft); addVertex(right); addVertex(left) end prevLeft, prevRight = left, right end end]==]
local TILT_TRANSFORM = {0.900447, 0.434966, 0, 0, -0.434966, 0.900447, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0.9, 0, 0, 1}

local FLOWER_COUNT = 6
local PETAL_COUNT = 7
local RING_RADIUS = 7.0
local PLACE_ONLY_SCENE = {actionFlags = {ActionFlag.SCENE_GRAPH_ACTION, ActionFlag.SCENE_STROBE_GRAPH_ACTION}}

local function must(ok, reason)
	if not ok then error(reason) end
end

-- A turn about Y, with local X carried to (cos a, 0, -sin a).
local function yTurn(angle, tx, tz)
	local c, s = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
	return {c, 0, -s, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, s, 0, c, 0, tx, 0, tz, 1}
end

local function buildFlower(k)
	local f = "flower" .. k
	local hub = f .. "Hub"
	local angle = (k - 1) * 2 * math.pi / FLOWER_COUNT

	-- Placed off the root frame rather than the cube's, so the flowers stay put while the cube turns.
	must(createSceneTransformNode{name = f .. "Place",
		transform = yTurn(angle, RING_RADIUS * math.cos(angle), -RING_RADIUS * math.sin(angle))})
	must(createSceneGeometryScriptNode{name = f .. "Body", pokeEnabled = true,
		coreScript = BODY_CORE, pokeScript = BODY_POKE})
	must(createSceneTransformNode{name = hub, transform = yTurn(0, 0, 0)})

	must(createEdge("rootTransform", f .. "Place"))
	must(createEdge(f .. "Place", f .. "Body"))
	must(createEdge(f .. "Body", hub))

	for p = 0, PETAL_COUNT - 1 do
		local tilt, petal = f .. "Tilt" .. p, f .. "Petal" .. p
		must(createSceneTransformScriptNode{name = tilt, transform = TILT_TRANSFORM, coreScript = TILT_CORE})
		must(createSceneGeometryScriptNode{name = petal,
			coreScript = "function init() local hue = " .. string.format("%.6f", p / PETAL_COUNT) .. PETAL_TAIL})

		if p == 0 then
			must(createEdge(hub, tilt))
		else
			local spoke = f .. "Spoke" .. p
			must(createSceneTransformNode{name = spoke, transform = yTurn(p * 2 * math.pi / PETAL_COUNT, 0, 0)})
			must(createEdge(hub, spoke))
			must(createEdge(spoke, tilt))
		end

		must(createEdge(tilt, petal))

		-- The last petal returns to the root frame for the next flower, but only for scene work: an animate
		-- action sent into this flower ends here instead of running on into the next one.
		if p < PETAL_COUNT - 1 then
			must(createEdge(petal, hub))
		else
			must(createEdge(petal, "rootTransform", PLACE_ONLY_SCENE))
		end
	end

	must(createEdge(getSelfName(), f .. "Body", {actionFlags = {ActionFlag.ANIMATE_GRAPH_ACTION}, traversalKey = k}))
end

function init()
	for k = 1, FLOWER_COUNT do buildFlower(k) end

	-- Set each new flower opening and closing straight away, rather than waiting for it to be poked.
	for k = 1, FLOWER_COUNT do emitAction(ActionType.ANIMATE, {animating = true}, {k}) end
end
